messages:
Maya R: Heads-up from vendor call: they want a consolidated marketplace cutover but prefer staggered public announcements across H100/H200 and MI300. They suggested H100 (partner OEM) Apr 12, H200 Apr 14, MI300 Apr 16. Can we sync on risks?

Kevin C: Staggered timeline is OK from comms POV but marketplace pipeline prefers a single cutover date. That means we need all images + SKUs merged by Apr 11. Any infra blockers? :calendar:

Jules P: If marketplace insists on single cutover, we can do "soft publish" of metadata earlier and only toggle visibility on cutover. Need to confirm it won't violate vendor embargo windows.

Elena S: EU capacity for MI300 is our bottleneck. Current forecast shows only 60% of requested nodes available Apr 15-20. We can re-route some MI300 traffic to US-W once we enable cross-region routing, but latency impact for EU customers needs sign-off.

Priya N: SI partners asked for a partner-only dry-run Apr 6-8 and an extended smoke window Apr 9-10. They'll test connectors and deployment playbooks. We promised staging artifacts by Apr 3; can build hit that date?

Kevin C: Build can cut staging images Apr 2 if we freeze the manifest by Apr 1 COB. Anything volatile in the image we should pin now (driver versions, kernel). Example manifest snippet vendor wants included in marketplace:
```
sku: h200-80
image_tag: redwood-h200-2026-04-02
driver_hash: sha256:abcd1234
compat_matrix: v2.1
```

Maya R: Vendor also requested joint release blurb (two bullets max) by Apr 5 for their PR team. I'll draft candidate language if someone can confirm technical accuracy.

Jules P: I'll prep the toggle plan and confirm marketplace behavior for early metadata publish. If toggle is allowed we can honor both vendor staggered announces and marketplace single cutover.

Elena S: Action: I'll try to free up 10 MI300 nodes via reassignments; outcome by EOD tomorrow. If not possible we'll accept US-W backfill and draft latency note.

Priya N: I'll send dry-run invites to SIs and include a checklist: staging image, driver hash, sample deployment templates, basic metrics to capture.

PartnerBot: Meeting created: "Vendor HW onramp - staggered announce vs single cutover" Mon Apr 1 09:30 PT. Invites sent to participants.

Kevin C: One more: we need a fallback statement in case GA slips beyond Apr 16. I'll draft a short fallback and drop it here.

Maya R: Great. Please keep updates concise in this thread. If you hit a blocker that changes the dates, ping me directly.

Jules P: Acked. Will share toggle runbook and marketplace confirmation by Apr 1 AM.

Elena S: Acked. Pinging infra now.

Priya N: Acked. Will confirm SI list and dry-run calendar invites by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Maya R: Thanks team — keeping this thread live for coordination only. End for now.
